name: Rosario
pointBasis: UN WUP 2025 population-weighted settlement centroid; this is not a municipal boundary or a parcel-coverage claim.
registryBasis: Official Municipalidad de Rosario Infomapa publishes city cadastral cartography, and its municipal open-data catalogue publishes full parcel polygons by cadastral section. A retained Section 9 polygon contains the unchanged WUP locator.
remainingUncertainty: Section 9 only; other cadastral sections, legal title, survey accuracy, and identity continuity across publisher replacements remain unverified. CSV MSLINK strings are preserved exactly; no equality with GML identifiers is claimed.
nextStep: Inspect enabled local source in headed app.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Official municipal parcel cartography published by cadastral section.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: Rosario municipal cadastral Section 9 only. The 7 October 2026 public CSV snapshot contains 15,854 distinct MSLINK strings and full embedded WGS84 polygons. Its exact strong ETag and feature count are pinned; unexpected revisions fail closed pending review. Thirteen aligned cells plus four pans around the unchanged WUP locator verified 826 distinct full geometries; all 826 fresh exact-ID reads reproduce geometry after a separate complete 5,148,842-byte HTTP 200 download. The WUP-containing parcel passes full footprint lookup and complete proposal binding. GEOS in EPSG:32720 found no invalid polygons, duplicate geometry, sampled overlaps above 0.01 m² or operation errors. Only geometry and six cadastral/code identifiers are retained; the CSV parser preserves string identity and rejects schema drift, invalid embedded geometry and malformed rows. No equality with differently formatted GML identifiers is claimed. Other sections, citywide completeness, legal title, survey accuracy and identity continuity after replacement remain unverified.
